create_cuda_combined_scheduling: create a CUDACombinedScheduling scheduler instance for CUDA kernel codegen with a Scheduler object
choose_node_backend: choose the appropriate backend (CUDA-C++ or Triton) for a given scheduler node
can_fuse_vertical: check whether two scheduler nodes can be fused vertically in CUDA combined scheduling
can_fuse_horizontal: check whether two scheduler nodes can be fused horizontally in CUDA combined scheduling
codegen_template: generate code for a template node with epilogue nodes using the appropriate CUDA or Triton backend
